an7.36:1.1: Sattahi bhikkhave aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo.
an7.36:1.3: Duddadaṃ dadāti, dukkaraṃ karoti, dukkhamaṃ khamati, guyham assa āvikaroti, guyham assa pariguyhati, āpadāsu na jahati, khīṇena nātimaññati.
an7.36:1.4: Imehi kho bhikkhave sattah' aṅgehi samannāgato bhikkhu mitto sevitabbo ti.
